item.title: San Diego Weather: Morning fog, warm afternoons
item.description: After a relentless stretch of record-breaking heat in March, the heat wave will begin to ease with a gradual cool-down this weekend.

item.title: Man sentenced to 10 months in human smuggling attempt that killed 4 off Del Mar coast
item.description: One of five people charged by federal prosecutors in connection with a maritime human-smuggling event that led to the deaths of four people -- including a teenager and a young girl -- off the coast of northern San Diego County last year was sentenced Monday to 10 months in prison.

item.title: Spring Training is over! Potential San Diego Padres Opening Day roster
item.description: The San Diego Padres played their final Spring Training game on Monday. So, what will their Opening Day roster look like?

item.title: Murder trial delayed for man accused of killing City Heights grandmother in 2023
item.description: Siliveinusi Hamala, 25, is accused of attacking a 65-year-old grandmother in a City Heights park near their homes.

item.title: San Diego airport sees long lines, no ICE officers amid ongoing shutdown
item.description: ICE officers are expected to begin handling some security duties at U.S. airports on Monday amid an ongoing partial government shutdown that has sidelined many Transportation Security Administration officers, with border czar Tom Homan in charge of the effort.

item.title: CBP officers find person in gas tank at San Ysidro Port of Entry
item.description: Emergency personnel took the person to Scripps Mercy Hospital in Chula Vista, for treatment of burn injuries sustained during the smuggling attempt.

item.title: America's wealth gap is growing, and Trump's policies are making it bigger
item.description: President Donald Trump has cut programs helping lower-income households while advancing policies benefiting the wealthy and corporations.

item.title: Krewella and MARINA headlining 2026 San Diego Pride
item.description: Krewella and MARINA were announced as the headlining acts for the 2026 San Diego Pride Festival, considered one of the largest Pride celebrations in the country.

item.title: She cleaned hospital floors at Yale for a decade. Now she's returning as a doctor
item.description: Shay Taylor is returning as an anesthesiology resident, and her emotional match day video is going viral.

item.title: San Diego Unified to begin name-change process for Cesar Chavez Elementary School
item.description: The San Diego Unified School District on Tuesday is expected to begin a process to change the name of Cesar Chavez Elementary School in Southcrest in light of sexual abuse allegations made last week against the labor leader.
